title: Stepping into The Smugglers' Cave (one room past the stair, then walking straight back down without going further) made all four companions declare their own hold-quests permanently 'behind us' ('Hollowbrook's behind us'... 'Cinderhall's behind us'... 'Coldpass already... Fenmarch's behind us now'... 'Coldpass, and Thornwold's behind us'), as if the point of no return had passed. I then walked the ordinary surface coast road to Fenmarch straight afterward and fully completed Brother Osk's quest there, proving the line was false. The real, correctly-worded warning ('Past this gate the holds fall behind you') only appears later, at The Pass Gate.
